scientific_integrity: The reported formula is proved using the explicit line configuration, Frobenius action on Picard, and exact incidence counting. Finite enumerations support but do not replace the all-q proof. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns odd finite fields of characteristic at least seven with q mod 5 equal to 2 or 3. It does not cover even fields, characteristic 3 or 5, or split q. Historical priority against inaccessible early finite-geometry tabulations remains unconfirmed.
title: Nonsplit Clebsch cubic: exact count of line-free rational points
